dialogo.s: คุณ|kun โทมัส|too-mát กำลัง|gam-lang เรียน|riian ภาษาไทย|paa-sǎa-tai อยู่|yùu
dialogo.fsi: khun thoomát kamlaŋ rian phaasǎathaj jùu
dialogo.en: Mr. Thomas is studying Thai

dialogo.fsi: thîi rooŋrian sɔ̌ɔn phaasǎa khɔ̌ɔŋ krasuaŋ tàaŋprathêet
dialogo.en: at the language school of the Department of State.
dialogo.pt: na escola de línguas do Departamento de Estado.

dialogo.s: เขา|kǎo เรียน|riian มา|maa ได้|dâai สอง|sɔ̌ɔng เดือน|dʉʉan แล้ว|lɛ́ɛo
dialogo.fsi: kháw rian maa dâj sɔ̌ɔŋ dʉan lɛ́ɛw
dialogo.en: He has been studying for two months.
dialogo.pt: Já estuda há dois meses.

dialogo.s: เขา|kǎo จะ|jà เรียน|riian อีก|ìik สี่|sìi เดือน|dʉʉan แล้ว|lɛ́ɛo จะ|jà ไป|bpai เมืองไทย|mʉʉang-tai
dialogo.fsi: kháw cà rian ʔìik sìi dʉan lɛ́ɛw cà paj mʉaŋthaj
dialogo.en: He will study four more months and then go to Thailand.
dialogo.pt: Vai estudar mais quatro meses e depois ir para a Tailândia.

dialogo.s: เขา|kǎo จะ|jà พา|paa ภรรยา|pan-rá-yaa และ|lɛ́ ลูกๆ|lûuk-lûuk ของ|kɔ̌ɔng เขา|kǎo ไป|bpai ด้วย|dûuai

dialogo.pt: Vai levar a esposa e os filhos junto.

dialogo.pt: Ele calcula sair de Washington no dia dez de julho

dialogo.en: and drive to his parents' house in Pennsylvania.
dialogo.pt: e ir de carro até a casa dos pais, na Pensilvânia.

dialogo.fsi: kháw cà phák jùu thîinân hâa wan

dialogo.pt: Vai ficar lá cinco dias

dialogo.pt: Calcula chegar a Bangkok lá pelo dia primeiro de agosto.

dialogo.pt: O senhor Thomas chegou a Bangkok no dia dois de agosto.

dialogo.fsi: kháw wâajnáam kan thúkwan
dialogo.en: They swim every day.
dialogo.pt: Eles nadam todos os dias.

dialogo.fsi: mʉ̂a sìp pii thîi lɛ́ɛw
dialogo.en: ten years ago.

dialogo.pt: Mas o senhor Thomas não sabia onde o amigo estava.

dialogo.pt: Lembrava que o amigo se chamava Sunthorn Mahasak.

dialogo.en: One day he opened the telephone book
dialogo.pt: Um dia ele abriu a lista telefônica

dialogo.s: เขา|kǎo พบ|póp ชื่อ|chʉ̂ʉ คุณ|kun สุนทร|sǔn-tɔɔn
dialogo.fsi: kháw phóp chʉ̂ʉ khun sǔnthɔɔn
dialogo.en: and found Sunthorn's name.
dialogo.pt: e achou o nome do Sunthorn.

dialogo.fsi: kháw thoo paj hǎa khun sǔnthɔɔn thîi bâan

dialogo.pt: Telefonou para o Sunthorn em casa.

dialogo.fsi: khun sǔnthɔɔn diicaj mâak
dialogo.en: Sunthorn was very glad.
dialogo.pt: O Sunthorn ficou muito contente.

dialogo.fsi: kháw chəən khun thoomát lɛ́ khrɔ̂ɔpkhrua paj thaan khâaw thîi bâan
dialogo.en: He invited Thomas and his family to dinner at his house.
dialogo.pt: Convidou o Thomas e a família para jantar na casa dele.

dialogo.en: Sunthorn's house is very beautiful.
dialogo.pt: A casa do Sunthorn é muito bonita.

dialogo.s: คุณ|kun สุนทร|sǔn-tɔɔn อยาก|yàak ให้|hâi ครอบครัว|krɔ̂ɔp-kruua โทมัส|too-mát พัก|pák อยู่|yùu กับ|gàp เขา|kǎo
dialogo.fsi: khun sǔnthɔɔn jàak hâj khrɔ̂ɔpkhrua thoomát phák jùu kàp kháw
dialogo.en: Sunthorn wanted Thomas's family to stay with him,
dialogo.pt: O Sunthorn queria que a família do Thomas ficasse com ele,

dialogo.en: but Thomas didn't want to trouble him.
dialogo.pt: mas o Thomas não queria incomodar.

vocab.th: สระว่ายน้ำ
สมุดโทรศัพท์

t.pt: Uma narrativa no tempo verbal tailandês

e.pt: O texto conta planos (จะ), coisas já feitas (มา…ได้…แล้ว) e o que aconteceu depois (เมื่อวันที่สอง…) sem mudar nenhum verbo — só as palavras de tempo e de aspecto mudam. Analogia: o verbo é um ator que veste figurinos diferentes (จะ, แล้ว, เคย) a cada cena.
e.en: Plans, completed actions and past events are told without inflection, only with time and aspect words.

notas.ex: เขา|kǎo จะ|jà ไป|bpai เมืองไทย|mʉʉang-tai

t.en: กะว่า: to figure that

e.pt: กะว่า + frase = 'calcular, ter a ideia de que': เขากะว่าจะถึงราววันที่หนึ่ง = ele calcula chegar lá pelo dia primeiro. É mais vago que ตั้งใจ (pretender firmemente).
e.en: กะว่า + clause: to estimate or plan roughly.

notas.ex: ผม|pǒm กะ|gà ว่า|wâa จะ|jà ไป|bpai พรุ่งนี้|prûng-níi

e.pt: แวะ é parar no caminho para outro destino: แวะเที่ยวโรม = parar para passear em Roma; แวะบ้านเพื่อน = passar na casa de um amigo.
e.en: แวะ: to stop somewhere on the way.

notas.ex: แวะ|wɛ́ บ้าน|bâan เพื่อน|pʉ̂ʉan
